demos.title: Cockpit space flight
demos.prompt: Build a seated space-flight game. The player sits in a cockpit with physical instruments: a throttle lever and a stick that are grabbed and moved, switches that flip, and readouts that update. Flying is Newtonian with thrust and drag-free inertia. Asteroids drift past and can be shot with a trigger-fired cannon; the ship takes damage and the hull readout falls. Comfort is the point of the brief: the cockpit frame is always visible and static relative to the player, and a vignette closes in during hard acceleration.
